label: first of {1,j,m,z,c,x,0} in early original steps (t=0,2,3,4); also copy step t=4
explanation: Update-gate unit that is active almost only early in the sequence: 96% of mass is in the original phase at absolute steps t=0,2,3,4 (t=1 is weak, and it is silent from t>=6). Within those steps it is token-selective: it fires on the first occurrence of a token from {1, j, m, z, c, x, 0}. Digit 1 dominates (35% firing rate, ~47% of mass) and fires even if another set token came earlier. The other set tokens mostly fire only when no set token has appeared yet. Weaker, partial firing on o, f, e. A small, high-magnitude component sits in the copy phase at absolute t=4 (L=3, recall step 1, input = orig(0)); the top activations are input 1 there, after an earlier 1 at t=0. Does not fire on repeated tokens, the delimiter, later copy steps, or most other letters. The token set and positions are graded rather than crisp, which limits precision and recall to about 0.75 F1.
